newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Credit Suisse on track to meet targets.
newsitem.headline: Credit Suisse on track to meet targets.

text.p: Credit Suisse Group, the Swiss banking group, said its new corporate structure was proving successful and it was confident of making significant steps in 1997 toward meeting its medium-term financial targets.

"Given the progress to date in the restructuring and the very good start to the year, Credit Suisse Group is confident that it will make significant steps toward achieving its medium-term financial targets in the course of 1997," Credit Suisse Group said in a statement.
